label: Closure
title: Account Closure Confirmation
description: Sent to confirm the formal termination of a client account.
subject: Account Closure Confirmation – HealthCheck
body:
Dear [Client Name], This email confirms that your HealthCheck account has been officially closed as of [Date], as per your request / our agreement. What this means: - All active call schedules have been stopped - Ongoing campaigns have been paused - Data will be retained for [X] days as per our data policy If you wish to reactivate your account in the future, please contact us at [Support Email].
